$Comment: The Headless Horseman in the saddle, the form his fight opens with: a Variant of Template_Flying_Aggressive (the game's flying hunters, such as the Incandescent skull) on his skeletal horse (his Appearance, the model Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Mounted, makes the horse walk and gallop while he flies). He circles low over his target, 1 to 3 blocks up so swords can reach him as he dips, and hurls a lantern bomb (Root_Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Bomb) at anyone within 18 blocks every 3 to 4 seconds. The fight's script swaps him to Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman on foot when he is worn down, and his health carries across, so MaxHealth here must equal that role's. Fire hurts him at half (Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Fire_Ward in _CombatConfig), never shoved (KnockbackScale 0), DropList Empty since his reward is the Claims his fight pays. Any key the template does not declare makes the game refuse the whole role.
